title: Eric Ries on TikTok: 'A McDonald's Big Mac Costs $7 Today. Costco Still Sells a Hot Dog and Soda Combo for $1.50.'
summary: Eric posts the longer-form video (151 sec) of the Costco hot-dog-price story — building out the case study with the Big Mac price comparison and explicitly framing it as a clip from Incorruptible.
blockquote:
A McDonald's Big Mac costs $7 today.
Costco still sells a hot dog and soda combo for $1.50.
Why? Because of what happened the day the COO said they had to raise the price.
From INCORRUPTIBLE — out May 26
